why: A delivers every piece the client named: a tall dark bookcase, a warm cognac armchair, a reading lamp, a walnut side table and a light round jute rug, all in a cohesive warm, natural palette. Its only weakness is that a single 90 cm bookcase covers less of the wall than requested. B misses key requirements: its bookcases are low and medium-toned, its rug is rectangular and striped, and its bulky dark recliner and mixed industrial and graphic pieces don't form a unified look.
